title: 第5章 山中苦修第6章 修武之路
lines: 萧羽来到了萧家后山的边缘，按照小刀的说法，他现在的实力简直是弱爆了。
如果直接进入落日山脉，很大的可能直接就会被妖兽给吃了，如果更倒霉一点，碰到地阶以上的妖兽遛弯，很可能一个喷嚏就把他给灭了。
虽然对于小刀的鄙视，萧羽有些不服气，但是萧羽确实知道，饭要一口一口吃的道理。
“看到没有，那里有个半人高的石头，约莫有两百斤左右，你去把他绑在背上。”小刀的声音出现在萧羽的脑海中。
此时小刀完全没有了平时的嬉皮笑脸，俨然一副严师的样子。
萧羽也是知道轻重，走过去将石头绑好，然后发力将石头绑在了自己的背上，今天小刀安排给萧羽的训练就是背上这块石头斩杀一头一级妖兽风狼......
此时在落日山脉深处的一座山峰上，一位脸遮面纱的白裙女子，正坐在山峰顶端的一颗巨树的树冠之上，双腿之上还有一副古琴，随着一双灵巧的双手的舞动，琴声时而悠扬，时而高亢，轻柔时如微风，白云，紧张时如狂风骤雨！
“大姐，你弹得琴真好听。”这时一个同样戴着面纱的灵动少女，双手提着裙角跑了过来。
“四妹，最近外面可是又有什么事情发生？弹琴女子开口问道，声音如黄鹂般好听。
“大姐，还是上次的那件事呗，现在在青山镇可是最热的话题了。”
灵动少女急忙开口道：“大姐，你说那个萧羽到底是一个怎样的人啊？竟然选择用这样一种方式结束自己的生命！
如果是我，我是绝对做不出来的，想想都疼死了。”
”好了，如果只是这些无聊的事情就不必和我说了，可有少主的消息？”
“大姐，问题的关键是那个废物少爷，是用石头把自己一点一点的砸死的，你说可怕不可怕？
至于少主，连是男是女，长得什么样子都不知道，怎么找？”
“确实如此，这个萧羽倒真是个有血性的男儿！”弹琴的女子道：“四妹，你二姐和三姐可是还在修炼？”
“那两个武疯子，每次被你揍完，不就是开始拼命修炼吗？
要我看啊，修炼也是没什么用，还是要被你揍！年年如此，烦都烦死了，大姐我们什么时候可以离开这里啊？”
“当年主人把我们四人留在这里，并让树爷爷教导我们，就是让我们等待少主。如果少主出现，主人留在这里的封禁自会解开。
所以我们要努力修炼，守卫少主，你切不可贪玩耽误了修行，不然我可不饶你！”
“好了，好了大姐，我知道了，我现在已经是灵武境巅峰呢。每次找你聊天都是被你训斥，真是无趣！”说完少女逃也似的跑开了......
白裙女子看着逃也是离开的少女，不由得摇头！
主人，还有少主，你们到底在哪里啊？
此时的萧羽正在狼狈的与一头风狼进行肉搏，对就是肉搏！没有任何的武技和招式。
萧羽此时身背巨石，气喘吁吁，他已经与这头风狼打了一个时辰了，除了薅了一地的狼毛外，就是掰断了风狼的一颗獠牙！
这让这头风狼暴怒不止！
而萧羽的状态可以用惨不忍睹来形容也不为过，浑身上下都是狼爪挠出的血痕，胸口的血痕深可见骨，胳膊是还有两个血洞，血流不止。
他现在不敢去止血，只要露出一点破绽，这头风狼一定会要了他的命，一人一狼就这样对峙着。
“你这个蠢货，除了蛮干能不能动点脑子？
风狼的特点是什么，速度快，爆发力强，头骨是它身体上最坚硬的地方，你揍它的头有什么用？还有你能跑得过它吗？
当它攻击的时候你要做的不是硬刚，也不是转身逃跑，而是要躲闪，同时它的腰和腹部才是弱点！提起精神它进攻了。”小刀训斥道。
风狼蓄力之后一跃而起向萧羽扑来，萧羽一个懒驴打滚，向一侧滚去，躲过风狼的攻击。
风狼一声嚎叫再次扑来，几个回合以后，风狼似乎有些累了，几次扑咬都被这个小子灵活的躲了过去。
萧羽也从最开始的懒驴打滚，到现在的小范围腾挪就可以躲避它的进攻，所以它几次的扑咬都是无效的。
这时萧羽背着石头突然往前走了几步，风狼眼神一缩，再次跃起，扑来，萧羽突然加速，躬身蹬腿，蓄力，一记冲天拳狠狠的打在了风狼的腹部，风狼一声惨叫摔落在地！
趁他病要他命！
萧羽在风狼落地的一瞬间，长身跃起，双肘弯曲，向下砸去，只听一声惨嚎，风狼的腰骨登时断裂。
萧羽翻身而起，提起风狼的两条后腿，像打摆子一样，不停的将风狼抡起来向地面摔砸，血腥而暴力，直到这头风狼完全像面条一样才停手！
小刀嘿嘿一笑：“暴力美学，不过我喜欢。好了，今天就到这里，提起这头风狼，尽全力跑回去。”

content_en:
Xiao Yu came to the edge of the Xiao family's back hill. According to Xiao Dao, his current strength was simply too weak.
If you enter the Sunset Mountains directly, you will most likely be eaten by a monster. If you are more unlucky and encounter a monster walking above the ground level, you will probably kill it with a sneeze.
Although Xiao Yu was a little dissatisfied with Xiao Dao's contempt, Xiao Yu did know that the meal should be eaten one bite at a time.
"See, there is a stone half a man tall there, weighing about two hundred kilograms. Go and tie it to your back." The voice of the knife appeared in Xiao Yu's mind.
At this time, Xiaodao completely lost his usual playful smile and looked like a strict teacher.
Xiao Yu also knew the importance, so he walked over and tied the stone, and then used force to tie the stone to his back. Today Xiao Dao arranged for Xiao Yu to train with this stone on his back to kill a first-level monster wind wolf...
At this time, on a peak deep in the Sunset Mountains, a woman in a white dress with her face covered by a veil was sitting on the crown of a giant tree at the top of the mountain. There was a guqin on her legs. With the dance of a pair of dexterous hands, the sound of the piano was sometimes melodious, sometimes high-pitched, sometimes gentle like a breeze or white clouds, sometimes like a violent storm!
"Sister, you play the piano so beautifully." At this time, an agile girl also wearing a veil ran over, holding the hem of her skirt with both hands.
"Fourth sister, what happened outside recently? The girl playing the piano asked, her voice as beautiful as an oriole.
"Sister, it's still the same thing as last time. Now it's the hottest topic in Qingshan Town. "
The smart girl hurriedly said: "Sister, what kind of person do you think that Xiao Yu is? He actually chose to end his life in such a way!
If it were me, I would never be able to do it. It hurts to death just thinking about it. "
"Okay, if it's just these boring things, you don't need to tell me. Is there any news about the young master? "
"Sister, the key to the problem is that the good-for-nothing young master used stones to beat himself to death bit by bit. Do you think it's scary or not?
As for the young master, I don’t even know whether he is a boy or a girl or what he looks like, so how can he find her? "
"Indeed, this Xiao Yu is really a bloody man! The woman playing the piano said: "Fourth sister, are your second and third sisters still practicing?" "
"Those two martial arts lunatics, every time they are beaten by you, don't they just start practicing hard?
Let me see, practicing is of no use, and I will still be beaten by you! It's like this every year, it's annoying me to death. Sister, when can we leave here? "
"The master left the four of us here and asked Grandpa Shu to teach us, just to let us wait for the young master. If the young master appears, the ban on the master staying here will be lifted.
Therefore, we must work hard to cultivate and guard the young master. You must not be playful and delay your cultivation, otherwise I will not spare you! "
"Okay, okay sister, I understand, I am now at the peak of the Lingwu Realm. Every time I chat with you, I get scolded by you. It’s so boring! "After saying that, the girl ran away as if running away...
The woman in the white dress looked at the girl who was running away and could not help but shake her head!
Master, and Young Master, where are you?
...
At this time, Xiao Yu was having a hand-to-hand fight with a wind wolf in embarrassment, that's right, a hand-to-hand fight! There are no martial arts or moves.
Xiao Yu was carrying a boulder on his back and was out of breath. He had been fighting with the wind wolf for an hour. In addition to the wolf fur all over the ground, he also broke off one of the wind wolf's fangs!
This made the wind wolf furious!
It would not be an exaggeration to describe Xiao Yu's condition as horrific. There were blood marks all over his body from the scratches of the wolf's claws. The blood marks on his chest were so deep that he could even see the bones. There were two blood holes in his arms and the blood was flowing non-stop.
He didn't dare to stop the bleeding now. As long as there was any flaw, the wind wolf would definitely kill him. One person and one wolf were facing each other like this.
"You idiot, can you use your brain instead of being reckless?
What are the characteristics of the wind wolf? It is fast and explosive. The skull is the hardest part of its body. What is the use of beating its head? And can you outrun it?
When it attacks, what you have to do is not to be strong, nor to turn around and run away, but to dodge. At the same time, its waist and abdomen are its weak points! Picking up the spirit it attacked. "Xiao Dao scolded.
After accumulating strength, Feng Lang jumped up and rushed towards Xiao Yu. Xiao Yu rolled to one side to avoid Feng Lang's attack.
The wind wolf howled and pounced again. After a few rounds, the wind wolf seemed to be a little tired, and the boy nimbly dodged the several bites.
Xiao Yu also rolled around like a lazy donkey at the beginning, and now he can avoid its attacks by moving in a small area, so its several bites are ineffective.
At this time, Xiao Yu suddenly took a few steps forward with the stone on his back. Feng Lang shrank his eyes, jumped up again, and rushed towards him. Xiao Yu suddenly accelerated, bent down and kicked his legs, accumulating strength, and hit Feng Lang in the abdomen with a soaring fist. Feng Lang screamed and fell to the ground!
Kill him while he's sick!
The moment Feng Lang landed on the ground, Xiao Yu jumped up, bent his elbows, and smashed down. He heard a miserable howl, and Feng Lang's waist bones immediately broke.
Xiao Yu stood up, lifted up the wind wolf's two hind legs, and kept swinging the wind wolf up and smashing it to the ground like a swing. It was bloody and violent, and he didn't stop until the wind wolf was completely like noodles!
Xiaodao chuckled: "Violent aesthetics, but I like it. Okay, that’s it for today, pick up this wind wolf and run back with all your strength. "
